cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer – Refurbishment to join our team.
This position is in the Robotics Surgical Technology (RST) organization and reports to the Director of Refurbishment Operations. Travel between locations will be required and is estimated to be ≤ 25%.
Manufacturing engineering and analytical skills, along with the ability to work cross-functionally, are critical to success in this position. This function will support growing and expanding an asset utilization and product refurbishment strategy for the [Product name masked] platform that delivers lower cost solutions to service and maintain systems.
Prior experience with creating and implementing refurbishment or remanufacturing is highly desirable. Candidates with this experience should ensure it is clearly highlighted in their work history.
A successful candidate will enter this position with demonstrated application of technical and operations/manufacturing experience.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Leverage product and reliability SMEs to help conduct a thorough analysis of end items to determine the technical feasibility of refurbishment. Using the output, assess the financial worthiness of implementation by completing a total cost rollup and comparing against established new build pricing. Plan and maintain accountability to the scope, budget, and project schedule for your assigned work activities. Plan, document, and execute project schedules that integrate a variety of operational and cross-functional deliverables to achieve full implementation of refurbishment offerings. Schedule and lead team meetings as necessary. Strong communication skills – verbal and written – are essential for this role. Responsible for process development and ongoing maintenance of work instructions and configuration management associated with refurbishment offerings. Proactively develop risk mitigation and recovery plans with clear action steps defining what must be true to meet the expectations and influence others to follow.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or related field.
4+ Years of experience in manufacturing, operations, and/or service, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and planning skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Strong leadership skills.
Ability to discuss technical details with engineering staff; the ideal candidate will have a strong engineering and product development background.
Ability to drive action and effect change.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in refurbishment / remanufacturing.
Advanced technical degree.
Experience with regulated and/or safety-critical systems (medical device experience strongly preferred).
Comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment.

We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
This position is in the Robotics Surgical Technology (RST) organization and reports to the Director of Refurbishment Operations. Travel between locations will be required and is estimated to be ≤ 25%.
Manufacturing engineering and analytical skills, along with the ability to work across functions, are important for this role. This function will support the growth and expansion of an asset utilization and product refurbishment strategy for the [Product name masked] platform, working with others to deliver lower cost solutions to service and maintain systems.
Prior experience with creating and implementing refurbishment or remanufacturing is highly desirable. Candidates with this experience should ensure it is clearly highlighted in their work history.
A successful candidate will bring demonstrated technical and operations/manufacturing experience to the team.
cond_0252.responsibilities: Coordinate with product and reliability SMEs to conduct a thorough analysis of end items and determine the technical feasibility of refurbishment. Using the output, work with stakeholders to assess the financial worthiness of implementation by completing a total cost rollup and comparing against established new build pricing. Help maintain accountability to the scope, budget, and project schedule for assigned work activities. Plan, document, and coordinate project schedules that integrate a variety of operational and cross-functional deliverables to achieve full implementation of refurbishment offerings. Schedule and facilitate team meetings as necessary. Strong communication skills – verbal and written – are essential for this role. Share responsibility for process development and ongoing maintenance of work instructions and configuration management associated with refurbishment offerings. Work with the team to develop risk mitigation and recovery plans with clear action steps defining what must be true to meet expectations, and help align others around those plans.
cond_0252.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or related field is required.
4+ Years of experience in manufacturing, operations, and/or service, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and planning skills.
Experience in refurbishment / remanufacturing is highly desired.
Advanced technical degree is desired.
Experience with regulated and/or safety-critical systems (medical device experience strongly preferred).
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Strong leadership skills.
Comfortable working in a fast paced, cross-disciplinary environment.
Ability to discuss technical details with engineering staff; the ideal candidate will have a strong engineering and product development background.
Ability to drive action and effect change.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

This position is in the Robotics Surgical Technology (RST) organization and reports to the Director of Refurbishment Operations. Travel between locations will be required and is estimated to be ≤ 25%.
Strong manufacturing engineering and analytical skills, along with the ability to work across functions and stay in regular contact with a range of teams, are critical to success in this position. This function is central to growing and expanding an asset utilization and product refurbishment strategy for the [Product name masked] platform that delivers lower cost solutions to service and maintain systems.
Prior experience with creating and implementing refurbishment or remanufacturing is highly desirable. Candidates with this experience should ensure it is clearly highlighted in their work history.
A successful candidate will enter this position with demonstrated application of technical and operations/manufacturing experience.
cond_0330.responsibilities: Regularly connect with product and reliability SMEs to conduct a thorough analysis of end items and determine the technical feasibility of refurbishment. Using the output, assess the financial worthiness of implementation by completing a total cost rollup and comparing against established new build pricing. Plan and maintain accountability to the scope, budget, and project schedule for your assigned work activities. Plan, document, and execute project schedules that bring together a variety of operational and cross-functional deliverables to achieve full implementation of refurbishment offerings. Schedule and lead team meetings as needed, actively contributing to discussions and keeping stakeholders aligned. Clear, frequent communication with colleagues and cross-functional partners — both verbal and written — is a central part of this role. Responsible for process development and ongoing maintenance of work instructions and configuration management associated with refurbishment offerings. Proactively develop risk mitigation and recovery plans with clear action steps, initiate conversations to clarify what must be true to meet expectations, and bring people together to follow through.
cond_0330.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or related field.
4+ Years of experience in manufacturing, operations, and/or service, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and planning skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical details clearly to engineering staff and walk stakeholders through decisions.
Ability to initiate action and effect change.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in refurbishment / remanufacturing.
Advanced technical degree.
Experience with regulated and/or safety-critical systems (medical device experience strongly preferred).
Strong leadership skills.
Comfortable working in a busy, cross-disciplinary environment.
Strong engineering and product development background.

cond_0330.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

This position is in the Robotics Surgical Technology (RST) organization and reports to the Director of Refurbishment Operations. Travel between locations will be required and is estimated to be ≤ 25%.
Strong manufacturing engineering and analytical skills coupled with the ability to work in a cross-functional capacity are critical to success in this position. This function will own a growing asset utilization and product refurbishment strategy for the [Product name masked] platform, delivering lower cost solutions to service and maintain systems.
Prior experience with creating and implementing refurbishment or remanufacturing is highly desirable. Candidates with this experience should ensure it is clearly highlighted in their work history.
A successful candidate will enter this position with demonstrated application of technical and operations/manufacturing experience.
cond_0422.responsibilities: Lead a thorough analysis of end items — drawing on product and reliability SMEs — to determine the technical feasibility of refurbishment. Using the output, assess the financial worthiness of implementation by completing a total cost rollup and comparing against established new build pricing. Own accountability for the scope, budget, and project schedule for assigned work activities. Plan, document, and execute project schedules that integrate a variety of operational and cross-functional deliverables to achieve full implementation of refurbishment offerings. Chair team meetings as necessary. Strong communication skills – verbal and written – are essential for this role. Take ownership of process development and ongoing maintenance of work instructions and configuration management associated with refurbishment offerings. Proactively develop risk mitigation and recovery plans with clear action steps defining what must be true to meet expectations, and drive others to follow.
cond_0422.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or related field.
4+ Years of experience in manufacturing, operations, and/or service, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and planning skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Strong leadership skills.
Ability to discuss technical details with engineering staff; strong engineering and product development background.
Ability to drive action and effect change.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in refurbishment / remanufacturing.
Advanced technical degree.
Experience with regulated and/or safety-critical systems (medical device experience strongly preferred).
Comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment.
cond_0422.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

Strong manufacturing engineering and analytical skills, along with the ability to work across functions and coordinate with others, are critical to success in this position. This function will work closely with cross-functional teams to grow and expand an asset utilization and product refurbishment strategy for the [Product name masked] platform that delivers lower cost solutions to service and maintain systems.
Prior experience with creating and implementing refurbishment or remanufacturing is highly desirable. Candidates with this experience should ensure it is clearly highlighted in their work history.
A successful candidate will enter this position with demonstrated application of technical and operations/manufacturing experience.
cond_0477.responsibilities: Coordinate with product and reliability SMEs to conduct a thorough analysis of end items and determine the technical feasibility of refurbishment. Using the output, work with stakeholders to assess the financial worthiness of implementation by completing a total cost rollup and comparing against established new build pricing. Share accountability for scope, budget, and project schedule across assigned work activities. Plan, document, and execute project schedules that bring together a variety of operational and cross-functional deliverables to achieve full implementation of refurbishment offerings. Facilitate team meetings as necessary. Strong communication skills – verbal and written – are essential for this role. Collaborate on process development and ongoing maintenance of work instructions and configuration management associated with refurbishment offerings. Work with others to develop risk mitigation and recovery plans with clear action steps defining what must be true to meet expectations, and help align the team around those plans.
cond_0477.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or related field.
4+ Years of experience in manufacturing, operations, and/or service, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and planning skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to discuss technical details with engineering staff, with a strong engineering and product development background.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in refurbishment / remanufacturing.
Advanced technical degree.
Experience with regulated and/or safety-critical systems (medical device experience strongly preferred).
Strong leadership skills.
Comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment.
Ability to drive action and effect change.

This position is in the Robotics Surgical Technology (RST) organization and reports to the Director of Refurbishment Operations. Travel between locations will be required and is estimated to be ≤ 25%.
Manufacturing engineering and analytical skills, along with the ability to work across functions, are important for this role. This function will support the growth and expansion of an asset utilization and product refurbishment strategy for the [Product name masked] platform, working with others to deliver lower cost solutions to service and maintain systems.
Prior experience with creating and implementing refurbishment or remanufacturing is highly desirable. Candidates with this experience should ensure it is clearly highlighted in their work history.
A successful candidate will bring demonstrated technical and operations/manufacturing experience to the team.
cond_0594.responsibilities: Coordinate with product and reliability SMEs to conduct a thorough analysis of end items and determine the technical feasibility of refurbishment. Using the output, work with stakeholders to assess the financial worthiness of implementation by completing a total cost rollup and comparing against established new build pricing. Help maintain accountability to the scope, budget, and project schedule for assigned work activities. Plan, document, and coordinate project schedules that integrate a variety of operational and cross-functional deliverables to achieve full implementation of refurbishment offerings. Schedule and facilitate team meetings as necessary. Strong communication skills – verbal and written – are essential for this role. Share responsibility for process development and ongoing maintenance of work instructions and configuration management associated with refurbishment offerings. Work with the team to develop risk mitigation and recovery plans with clear action steps defining what must be true to meet expectations, and help align others around those plans.
cond_0594.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or related field is required.
4+ Years of experience in manufacturing, operations, and/or service, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and planning skills.
Experience in refurbishment / remanufacturing is highly desired.
Advanced technical degree is desired.
Experience with regulated and/or safety-critical systems (medical device experience strongly preferred).
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Strong leadership skills.
Comfortable working in a fast paced, cross-disciplinary environment.
Ability to discuss technical details with engineering staff; the ideal candidate will have a strong engineering and product development background.
Ability to drive action and effect change.
